usage: Used for a market in the business sense: the place or customer base where a product sells. It is common in planning, sales, and marketing talk.
Often appears in phrases like expanding into a market, entering a market, or studying the market. Very natural in company-growth contexts.
Can also mean the general market conditions or demand for a product, not only a physical marketplace.
A plain, neutral business word. For learners, it is one of the most useful nouns when talking about customers, competition, and growth.
